title: Ivo and the Glasshouse
author: Sable Pemberton
blurb: Casper Fairweather, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
